map.TKI 治疗中按 ELN 2020 标准评估 BCR-ABLIS 分子学反应层级: Grade the BCR-ABL international scale molecular response during TKI therapy under the ELN 2020 criteria.

map.达深度反应(MR4 以上≥2 年)后评估无治疗缓解(TFR)条件: Once a deep response is reached (MR4 or deeper for at least 2 years), assess whether the conditions for treatment-free remission (TFR) are met.
map.BCR-ABLIS 层级：≤0.0032% MR4.5、≤0.01% MR4/D: BCR-ABL international scale levels: 0.0032% or less is MR4.5, 0.01% or less is MR4/DMR, 0.1% or less is MMR, 1% or less is the CCyR range, 10% or less means CCyR not reached, and above 10% is high risk. Time-dependent response (ELN 2020): 1% or less at 3 months, 0.1% or less at 6 and 12 months; missing the matching threshold is graded as warning or treatment failure.
Example (12 months of treatment, BCR-ABL international scale = 0.5%): the level is the CCyR range (0.1 < 0.5 ≤ 1); the 12-month target is 0.1% or less and 0.5% is above it, so the response is a warning, calling for a review of adherence and resistance and shorter monitoring intervals. Another example (6 months, 0.05%): the level is MMR and the 6-month target of 0.1% or less is met, so the response is optimal.
map.BCR-ABLIS 是什么单位？: What unit is BCR-ABL on the international scale?
map.IS 即 International Scale，将不同实验室结果校准到统一标准: IS stands for International Scale, which calibrates results from different laboratories to a common standard in percent. It removes platform differences so results can be compared across centres; always state IS on the reading and in the report.
map.MR4 与 DMR 一样吗？: Are MR4 and DMR the same?
map.MR4=≤0.01%（较基线下降 4 个对数级），DMR（深度分子学反应）常指: MR4 means 0.01% or less, a 4-log reduction from baseline, while DMR (deep molecular response) usually means MR4 or deeper such as MR4.5. Patients who keep MR4 or deeper for at least 2 years and meet the other conditions can be assessed for TFR, stopping treatment under observation.
